entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Charlie, I want to return this helmet I bought. This is ridiculous. I've been trying to get this sorted for days and your website is useless. I want a refund now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet?

The issue is that I don't want it! The color is completely wrong, it looks nothing like the picture. This bright orange is a safety hazard, I wanted matte black. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging, the box is unopened! Just process the return. Get me your manager if you can't do it.

I understand. I don't need to get a manager involved, I should be able to handle this for you. I just need to pull up your order to check our return policy against your purchase date. Can I have your order number, please?
It's VF-8675309. You guys better not give me the runaround on this, or I'll be posting reviews everywhere.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 35 days ago.
And? I told you, the box is unopened! Are you going to deny this?

Not at all, sir. According to our policy here, standard items like this helmet have a 90-day return window. Since you're at day 35, you are well within that period. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's what I wanted. A full refund, back to my card?

Yes, absolutely. Once we receive the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. I've just initiated the return in our system, and I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
